productDecisionNotes: ARCHITECTURE.md (section 8, line ~256) prefers GitHub OAuth App flow over raw PAT paste when scope permits. DESIGN.md section 13 explicitly specifies a masked PAT-input UI pattern as part of the design system. docs/figma/SCREEN_INVENTORY.md explicitly lists 'Dashboard / Tokens / Add' as a required screen. Resolution used (not a silent invention, reconciles both docs): the Add screen presents 'Connect with GitHub OAuth' as the primary, recommended path (Continue with GitHub button, matching M01's OAuth entry pattern) and offers the DESIGN.md masked-input PAT field as a clearly labeled 'Advanced' fallback section beneath it. No raw token value is ever rendered in either path.

DESIGN.md's sidebar nav list (section 10.1) does not include a distinct 'Tokens' top-level item; PRODUCT_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md lists Tokens under User-area screens alongside Settings. Resolution: the Settings nav item is shown as Selected (State=Selected swap) on all Tokens screens, since no separate Tokens nav entry exists in the current design system. This is a design placement choice, not an invented product requirement — flagged as a known follow-up below in case a future module wants a dedicated 'Tokens' or 'Authorization' nav entry.
figma.supersededByScopeCorrection: IMPORTANT (2026-08-17 record correction): the entire Figma section above (9 frames: Dashboard / Tokens / Default, Empty, Loading, Error, Add, Delete Confirmation, Revoke Success, Disabled, Mobile) describes a per-user, OAuth-or-PAT, session-owned Tokens screen under a user dashboard. As of the 2026-08-17 product scope correction there are no end-user accounts and no per-user Tokens dashboard — that entire screen set and its backing route (apps/web/app/(protected)/tokens/) were deleted from the live codebase. The current, live token UI is two much simpler screens with NO Figma design pass performed for either: (1) a public, no-login 'Submit a GitHub token' form at apps/web/app/submit-token/page.tsx (paste-only, no OAuth option, no list/empty/loading/error/delete-confirmation/disabled/mobile states — just a form + success confirmation + inline error), and (2) an admin-only 'Admin / Tokens' list+deactivate screen at apps/web/app/(protected)/admin/tokens/page.tsx, whose own doc comment explicitly states 'No Figma frame exists yet for this screen... A follow-up Figma design pass is recommended before this is considered visually final.' This module's Figma work is NOT complete against the current, corrected product scope — recorded honestly here as a known gap rather than silently marking figma checks PASS against screens that no longer exist. See knownIssues below.

backend.summary: CURRENT STATE (corrected 2026-08-17): AES-256-GCM token-crypto (lib/token-crypto.ts — fresh IV per encrypt, auth-tag verified, fail-closed decrypt) is unchanged and still in use. Token submission is now PUBLIC and OWNERLESS: POST /api/public/tokens (no auth guard — the one deliberate no-session-required mutating route in this codebase) accepts a raw PAT, rate-limits by IP (lib/rate-limit.ts, in-memory token-bucket, 5/60s — documented follow-up to move to Redis before real public-scale traffic), zod-validates against PAT_PATTERN, encrypts, stores a precomputed maskedIdentifier, and never echoes/logs the raw value. GithubToken has no userId column (dropped by migration 20260817050000) — every row is a global, admin-visible resource, same ownership model as Finding/Flag. Admin-facing read/manage: GET /api/tokens (list, admin-only) and PATCH /api/tokens/:id (soft-delete deactivate, admin-only, idempotent) via lib/admin-tokens.ts, which never selects/returns the `encrypted` column.
